name: keel
description: Keel, GraphHelm's construction pattern for agents that write code, standalone: plan, execute, review and merge skills that need no Runtime, MCP or journeys.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, write, review and merge code under Keel's rules.
interface.longDescription: Keel is how code is built in GraphHelm, packaged for any project: one skill per step (plan, execute, review, merge) plus the values every step applies. It prefers the project's own KEEL.md, runs `graphhelm keel check` only when that CLI is installed, and needs no Runtime, MCP server, task records or journeys.
